hook: Five winter places that feel like a fairytale
caption:
Five places that look like a winter fairytale. ❄️

🌌 Rovaniemi, Finland — a snow forest under the northern lights.
🏘 Reine, Norway — red cabins framed by Arctic mountains.
✨ Colmar, France — glowing streets on a festive winter evening.
🏰 Tallinn, Estonia — a medieval skyline beneath snow.
🌨 Québec City, Canada — a real-life château in a winter cityscape.

Would you choose the northern lights or the old-town lights?

Photos: Dylan Shaw, Marianne Gay, Jametlene Reskp, Ilya Orehov & Lianhao Qu / Unsplash.

#YourTravelAtlas #WinterTravel #WinterWonderland #BucketListTravel
